ideas.pitch: A hybrid quantum-classical vehicle routing optimizer using Qiskit's VQE algorithm to minimize delivery fleet carbon footprints.
ideas.problem_statement: Qiskit Fall Fest 2026 @ MPSTME - Quantum Optimisation track
ideas.title: QuantumFlow Optima
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a trending sustainability theme with hard combinatorial optimization using native Qiskit circuits, directly addressing the optimization interest of IBM Quantum judges.

ideas.pitch: A Quantum Neural Network classifier built with Qiskit Machine Learning to detect anomalous credit card transaction patterns.
ideas.problem_statement: Qiskit Fall Fest 2026 @ MPSTME - Quantum Machine Learning (QML) / Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs)
ideas.title: QNN-FraudGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced QNN architecture on a relatable financial dataset, showing judges practical domain application rather than pure toy theory.

ideas.pitch: A hybrid quantum simulation tool using VQE to calculate the ground state energy of simple molecular bonds for drug discovery.
ideas.problem_statement: Qiskit Fall Fest 2026 @ MPSTME - Quantum Simulation
ideas.title: MoleculeSim Qiskit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a core scientific use-case for quantum hardware simulation, appealing to researchers and professors judging the event.

ideas.pitch: An LLM-backed interactive educational assistant that translates natural language prompts directly into executable Qiskit circuit code.
ideas.problem_statement: Qiskit Fall Fest 2026 @ MPSTME - Hybrid Quantum-Classical Computing
ideas.title: EntangleChat AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets developers and beginners learning Qiskit at the fest by lowering the barrier to entry through automated semantic code generation.

ideas.pitch: An interactive web debugger for step-by-step statevector visualization of Grover's search algorithm and amplitude amplification.
ideas.problem_statement: Qiskit Fall Fest 2026 @ MPSTME - Quantum Algorithms & Fundamentals
ideas.title: Quantum Grover Circuit Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: A polished developer tool that helps both judges and fellow students visualize complex quantum superposition and interference mechanics visually.
